results.content: A fresh round of polling is flashing new warning signs for President Donald Trump and Republicans ahead of the midterm elections. With control of Congress on the line, surveys released this week found Trump's approval rating near second-term lows while Democratic voters reported significantly greater enthusiasm about voting in November. One of the clearest warning signs for Republicans came from a Reuters/Ipsos survey released this week. Just 39% said they were satisfied with the direction of the country, down from 65% at the start of Trump's term and the lowest level recorded during his second presidency. results.content: # Trump approval rating hits new career low in latest AP-NORC poll. President Donald Trump’s approval rating hit a new career low in Associated Press-NORC polling, with less than one-third of surveyed Americans approving of his job performance in the White House. The poll, released Thursday, Oct. 1, found Trump’s approval rating at 31%, the lowest the president has seen in either of his two terms. Trump’s performance in Thursday’s poll also marks a two-percentage-point drop compared to the last AP-NORC poll in July.
